concept.controls: Left/Right or A/D: Move boat | Up/Down or W/S: Shorten or lengthen line | Space: Drop hook, then press again to release | Enter: Start
concept.core_mechanic: Every friend you catch changes the physics of the next drop. A dangling whale turns your hook into a wrecking-ball pendulum, a clingy octopus stretches the line like a bungee, and a jellyfish floats upward against the fall - so you must release each friend at just the right swing to arc them gently into the right tier of a stackable glass aquarium, heavy friends low or the whole tank tips.
concept.juice: Title screen: 'WHALE-WEIGHT AQUARIUM' with the whale dangling from the hook, swaying the whole title. Good landings make a soft splash, heart bubbles, a squash-and-stretch plop, and 'SOFT LANDING! +100'. Hard hits crackle 'TOO HARD!' with a screen shake and the tank rocking; a perfect gentle drop at the swing's peak trails sparkles and pops 'SPLASH-FREE! COMBO x3'.
concept.lose: Tip the tank, land three friends too hard, or use all 12 drops - 'THE TANK TIPPED! TRY AGAIN.'
concept.palette: Pale paper white, crayon red boat and octopus, soft blue whale, and sunny yellow lighthouse beam
concept.pitch: A wobbly physics puzzler where the friend on your hook completely changes how it swings, stretches, or floats. Plan each release to stack a whale, an octopus, and their pals safely into one tippy aquarium.

roles.role: Your movable crane boat at the top, carrying the hook, line, and winch
The heaviest catch and bottom-tier resident - on the hook he swings wide and slow, and placed high he will tip the tank
A stretchy catch whose clinging tentacles lengthen your line mid-swing, and a middle-tier resident who can grab and steady a rocking tank once
The harbormaster on the shore - its beam flashes yellow, then red, to warn of the wind gust that hits on the next drop
A floaty catch who rises instead of falling when released, needing the top tier, and who drifts upward if you mistime her

concept.title: Whale-Weight Aquarium
concept.win: Place all 6 friends in the right tiers in 12 drops or fewer - 'EVERYONE'S HOME! BEAUTIFULLY BALANCED.'

playtest.advice: Winnable, and no dumb policy wins.

runs.summary: Whale-Weight Aquarium is a cozy physics puzzler where you swing a whale, a stretchy octopus, and a floaty jellyfish from your crane boat and settle all six friends into their aquarium tiers before the tank tips. Move with Left/Right or A/D, lengthen or shorten the line with Up/Down or W/S, press Space to drop the hook and Space again at the right swing to release — do it gently, in 12 drops or fewer, to win.
